fullDescription: A high-performance agency landing page design featuring a sophisticated dark mode hero, editorial typography, and high-contrast lime-yellow accents. It utilizes glassmorphism for navigation, a dynamic 'expanding' flex-grid for statistics, and sticky-stacked project cards. The design is optimized for SaaS, creative agencies, and fintech companies looking for a bold, professional, and interactive digital presence.
prompt:
## Resumo
This design system, titled Marke, is built on a high-contrast foundation of Dark Blue (#081122) and Lime Yellow (#f5fe90). It features the 'Inter Tight' typeface for an editorial feel, using negative letter-spacing for large headings. Key interactive elements include flex-grow statistics cards, scroll-triggered rolling numbers, and a sticky-stacked project showcase that creates a layering effect during page navigation.

## Estilo Visual
Typography: Use 'Inter Tight' globally. H1 is 72px/80px height, -1.44px letter-spacing, weight 500. H2 is 56px/60px, -0.56px letter-spacing. Paragraphs are 16px/24px for standard text and 20px/30px for lead text. Colors: Primary Dark Blue #081122; Accent Yellow #f5fe90; Secondary Light Blue #b0e0ff; Light Green #bcffb0; Soft Purple #dad6ff; Background Gray #fbfaf9. Spacing: 80px for section padding; 40px for component gaps; 10px-24px for internal card padding. Borders: 1px solid #0811221a for light sections, transparent or white-tinted for dark sections. Animations: Hover states use 0.2s ease transitions. Buttons feature a dual-layer text wrap that slides vertically on hover, and statistics cards expand using flex-grow: 2 from a base of flex-grow: 1.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Floating Navigation
Layout: Fixed-top header with a centered 1360px wrapper. Navbar is a 100px border-radius capsule. Components: Left-aligned logo, centered menu items with dropdowns, right-aligned CTA. Styling: background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) with 5px backdrop-blur. Interaction: Dropdowns appear on hover with a 300ms fade/slide animation.

### Full-Height Hero
Layout: Flex-column, 100vh min-height. Background: Muted auto-playing video with a #081122 overlay. Content: Top-left has massive H1 headlines. Bottom-left contains a short description and a scrolling 'down' icon. Bottom-right features a 'Social Proof' box with a white-bordered logo cloud. Spacing: 222px top padding, 40px bottom padding.

### Dynamic Stats Grid
Layout: 3-column flex-row. Elements: Each card contains a massive H1 for the number and an P-text label. Interaction: On hover, the active card expands from flex-basis: 1 to flex-basis: 2, pushing the other cards aside smoothly. Numbers use a hidden overflow container with a vertical column of digits that translates on scroll to simulate a 'rolling counter' effect.

### Service Bento Grid
Layout: 3-column CSS Grid. Elements: Cards feature a 56x56px icon box with unique background colors (Yellow, Blue, Green, Purple). Headers are H5 (24px). Spacing: 16px grid gap. Card styling: padding 32px, 8px border-radius, #fbfaf9 background.

### Sticky Project Showcase
Layout: Vertical stack of large cards. Behavior: Each card is 'position: sticky; top: 80px'. As the user scrolls, cards stack on top of each other. Content: Left-side project details (Title, Client, Services), Right-side full-bleed image (max-width 743px). Styling: 12px border-radius, background #fbfaf9.

### Multi-Layer Footer
Layout: Two primary sections. Top Section: Large CTA with tag (#081122 background) and a primary request button. Bottom Section: 3-column grid for navigation links (Main Pages, Utility, Socials). Styling: #081122 background, #fff text. Divider: 1px line using #fff3.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Dual-Layer Slide Button — A button where text appears to be replaced by a second copy on hover.
Structure: Outer container with 'overflow: hidden'. Inner wrapper contains two identical text layers stacked vertically. Implementation: On hover, the inner wrapper translates -100% on the Y-axis. Transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1). Visuals: 100px border-radius, padding 4px-24px, right-side 46x46px circle containing an arrow icon.

### Interactive FAQ Accordion — A two-column grid of expanding questions.
Structure: Grid with 2 columns. Elements: Header with H3 text and a circular '+' icon. Body is hidden by default. Interaction: Header click rotates icon 45 degrees and expands body text with an opacity fade from 0 to 0.5 for the answer text. Border: 1px solid #0811221a at the bottom of each item.
